---
title: "Comisiones / Viáticos"
---

```{=html}
<div class="tf-page-header"><div><h1>Comisiones / Viáticos</h1><div class="tf-muted">El viático describe el viaje; los movimientos registran únicamente el dinero que realmente sale o entra.</div></div><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button></div>
<div class="tf-actions" style="margin-bottom:1rem"><button id="trip-new" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">Nuevo viático</button></div>

<section class="tf-card"><div class="tf-section-heading"><div><h2>Viáticos</h2><div class="tf-muted">El monto justificado corresponde a los comprobantes registrados en los gastos activos del viaje.</div></div><strong id="trip-count">0</strong></div><div class="tf-table-wrap"><table class="tf-table"><thead><tr><th>Viático</th><th>Inicio</th><th>Fin</th><th>Financiamiento</th><th class="tf-num">Monto total</th><th class="tf-num">Justificado</th><th>Estado</th><th>Información</th></tr></thead><tbody id="trip-list-body"></tbody></table></div></section>

<dialog id="trip-editor-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Viáticos</div><h2>Nuevo viático</h2></div><button id="trip-editor-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><form id="trip-form" class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Comisión / proyecto</label><input id="trip-name" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Destino</label><input id="trip-destination"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Monto total previsto / asignado ($)</label><input id="trip-total" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Inicio</label><input id="trip-start" type="date" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Fin</label><input id="trip-end" type="date"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Entidad que reembolsa</label><input id="trip-reimburser"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Financiamiento</label><select id="trip-funding"><option value="own_funds">Fondos propios</option><option value="advance">Anticipo de viáticos</option></select></div><div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Notas</label><input id="trip-notes"></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions tf-sticky-actions"><button id="trip-cancel" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cancelar</button><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar viático</button></div></form></dialog>

<dialog id="trip-detail-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Viático</div><h2 id="trip-detail-title">Información</h2></div><button id="trip-detail-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><div id="trip-detail-body"></div></dialog>

<dialog id="trip-expense-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Viático</div><h2>Registrar gasto</h2><div id="trip-expense-meta" class="tf-muted"></div></div><button id="trip-expense-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><form id="trip-expense-form" class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="trip-expense-date" type="date" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Categoría · subcategoría</label><select id="trip-expense-category-subcategory"></select></div><div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Descripción</label><input id="trip-expense-description"></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Total pagado ($)</label><input id="trip-expense-paid" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta usada</label><select id="trip-expense-account"></select></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Número de factura / comprobante</label><input id="trip-expense-invoice-number" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Valor justificado ($)</label><input id="trip-expense-invoiced" type="number" min="0" step="0.01"></div><div class="tf-field tf-check"><input id="trip-expense-has-vat" type="checkbox"><label>Registrar IVA del comprobante</label></div><div class="tf-field"><label>IVA incluido en el total ($)</label><input id="trip-expense-vat" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0" disabled></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Valor reconocido por la entidad ($)</label><input id="trip-expense-recognized" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div><div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Notas</label><input id="trip-expense-notes"></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions tf-sticky-actions"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Registrar gasto</button></div></form></dialog>

<dialog id="trip-reimbursement-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Fondos propios</div><h2>Registrar reembolso</h2><div id="trip-reimbursement-meta" class="tf-muted"></div></div><button id="trip-reimbursement-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><form id="trip-settlement-form" class="tf-form-grid"><div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha</label><input id="trip-settlement-date" type="date" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Monto recibido ($)</label><input id="trip-settlement-amount" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div><div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta destino</label><select id="trip-settlement-account"></select></div><div class="tf-field tf-span-2"><label>Notas</label><input id="trip-settlement-notes"></div><div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions tf-sticky-actions"><button class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Registrar reembolso</button></div></form></dialog>
<script type="module" src="js/business-trips.js?v=1.0.93"></script>
```
